hooks.command: f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||'')}catch(e){}})"); case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -40) ;; esac

msg=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.message)||'Claude needs your attention')}catch(e){process.stdout.write('Claude needs your attention')}})"); CLAUDE_HOOK_MSG="$msg" powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command 'Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show($env:CLAUDE_HOOK_MSG,"Claude Code")'
